The '''Huttbreaker's Rebellion''' was a revolt that occurred around the same time as the [[Conquest of Makeb]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Huttbreaker|Gritha Dar]] led other slaves, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], gun runners, former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and even [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] against the mercenaries of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The rebels caught the Hutt forces distracted by the events on [[Makeb]] and were victorious, naming the station [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Codex" />
